```{r}
#synprime screen analysis
#pycroquet 174 forward read - gRNA + scaffold + extension
# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "pycroquet_single_174_forward", pattern = "\\.counts\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  df <- read_tsv(file, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-`#id`, -unique_guide, -gene_pair_id, -sgrna_seqs) %>%
    rename(id = sgrna_ids)
  
  # Get the current count column name (not "id") and generate new name
  count_col <- setdiff(names(df), "id")
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>% str_remove("\\.counts$")
  new_colname <- paste0(sample_name, "_synprime_pyc_reads")
  
  df %>% rename(!!new_colname := all_of(count_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
synprime_reads <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "id")

synprime_reads
```

```{r}
#get rid of Re-Extraction label

synprime_reads <- synprime_reads %>%
  rename_with(~ str_remove(.x, "Re-Extraction_"))
```

```{r}
#function to sum lanes (2 lanes of Avitis have been sequenced)
collapse_lanes <- function(df, lane_regex = "_L[12]_PE_synprime_pyc_reads$") {
  # all lane-specific read columns (…_L1_reads or …_L2_PE_synprime_pyc_reads)
  laned <- names(df) %>% str_subset(lane_regex)
  if (length(laned) == 0) return(df)

  # base sample name without lane suffix
  bases <- str_replace(laned, lane_regex, "")
  groups <- split(laned, bases)  # list: base -> its lane columns

  # make combined columns by summing lanes row-wise
  for (b in names(groups)) {
    cols <- groups[[b]]
    df[[paste0(b, "_reads")]] <- rowSums(df[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # drop original lane columns
  df %>% select(-all_of(laned))
}
```

```{r}
#merge lane counts from Element Aviti
synprime_reads <- 
  collapse_lanes(synprime_reads)
synprime_reads
```

```{r}
#compute average reads for R1 and R2 
# 1) Identify R1/R2 column pairs
meta <- tibble(col = names(synprime_df)) %>%
  mutate(
    prefix = str_match(col, "^(.*)_R[12]_reads(.*)$")[, 2],
    suffix = str_match(col, "^(.*)_R[12]_reads(.*)$")[, 3]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prefix)) %>%
  group_by(prefix, suffix) %>%
  summarise(cols = list(col), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(lengths(cols) == 2)

# 2) Add averaged columns (keeps R1/R2)
synprime_df <- reduce(
  .x = seq_len(nrow(meta)),
  .init = synprime_df,
  .f = \(df, i) {
    cols <- meta$cols[[i]]
    # Build name cleanly, handling empty suffix
    parts <- c(meta$prefix[i], "average_reads", meta$suffix[i])
    parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]  # drop empty strings
    new_name <- paste(parts, collapse = "_")
    # Strip any leading underscore from suffix before joining
    new_name <- str_replace(new_name, "_+", "_")
    
    df %>%
      mutate(!!new_name := rowMeans(as.matrix(pick(all_of(cols))), na.rm = TRUE))
  }
)
synprime_df
```

```{r}
#these duplicates are an unfortunate introduction due to the fact that CGC as the first bases of the evopreq can match to other, shorter extension sequences. Secondly, the fact that we are introducing synonysmous variants means that some sysnonymous variants are the same as aothers (inteded plus bystander = bystander plus intended)
 
#this rare event equates to 94 duplications out of 5,302 pegRNAs -20 188 will be removed
synprime_df %>%
  select(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  distinct()

#duplicates
synprime_df %>%
  select(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  count(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

synprime_df %>%
  select(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  count(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  filter(n>1)

duplicate_pycroquet <- 
  synprime_df %>%
  select(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  count(sgrna_seqs) %>%
  filter(n>1)

duplicate_pycroquet

#this equates to 94 ids
#duplicate_pycroquet_ids
left_join(duplicate_pycroquet, synprime_df) %>%
  select(id) %>%
  distinct()

duplicate_pycroquet_ids <-
left_join(duplicate_pycroquet, synprime_df) %>%
  select(id) %>%
  distinct()

left_join(duplicate_pycroquet_ids, lib) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
#add mutation type
synprime_df <-
synprime_df %>%
 mutate(Edited.AA = str_remove_all(Edited.AA, ":")) %>%
  mutate(Edited.AA = str_remove_all(Edited.AA, "mut1")) %>%
    mutate(Edited.AA = str_remove_all(Edited.AA, "mut2")) %>%
    mutate(Edited.AA = str_remove_all(Edited.AA, "mut3")) %>%
    mutate(Edited.AA = str_remove_all(Edited.AA, "mut4")) %>%
    mutate(Edited.AA = str_remove_all(Edited.AA, "mut5")) %>%
  mutate(mutation_type = 
                              ifelse(Gene == "non-targeting", "non-targeting",
           ifelse(Original.AA == Edited.AA, "synonymous",
            ifelse(str_detect(Edited.AA, "STOP"), "nonsense", 
                   "missense"))))
```

```{r}
#DEPLETION - ROC versus NT
df <- synprime_df %>%
  mutate(
    class = case_when(
      mutation_type == "nonsense" & Gene == "KRAS" &  AA.number < 75 ~ "positive",
      mutation_type %in% c("non-targeting") ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    class = factor(class, levels = c("positive", "negative")) # order matters for yardstick
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(class))

df <- df %>% mutate(score = -L2FC_A427_PE_SYN_Control_average_zscore)

# n counts per group
n_counts <- df %>% count(class)
n_pos <- n_counts %>% filter(class == "positive") %>% pull(n)
n_neg <- n_counts %>% filter(class == "negative") %>% pull(n)

roc_data <- df %>%
  roc_curve(truth = class, score, event_level = "first")

auc_val <- df %>%
  roc_auc(truth = class, score, event_level = "first")

auc_val

annotation_label <- paste0(
  "AUC = ", round(auc_val$.estimate, 3), "\n",
  "n(nonsense) = ", n_pos, "\n",
  "n(non-targeting) = ", n_neg
)

ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_path(color = "salmon", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3, color = "gray50") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.6, y = 0.4,
    label = annotation_label,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "ROC: \nKRAS nonsense vs. non-targeting pegRNAs",
    x = "1 - specificity (FPR)",
    y = "sensitivity (TPR)", size = 2
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11.5)
  )
ggsave("ROC1.eps", width = 4.5, height = 4.5, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
#make a dot plot graph of resistance mutations - put data into long format - reshape
df_long_zscore <- 
  synprime_df %>%
  select(id, Gene, AA.number, Name, Mutation, mutation_type, exact, mm1, mm2, L2FC_A427_PE_SYN_Control_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_SYN_BI2865_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_SYN_ACBI3_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_SYN_RMC6236_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_SYN_MRTX1133_average_zscore) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, Gene, AA.number, Name, Mutation, mutation_type, exact, mm1, mm2), names_to = "drug", values_to = "z_score") %>%
  distinct()

#rename columns to join to sensor data
df_long_zscore <-
  df_long_zscore %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_Control_"), "control", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_BI2865_"), "BI-2865", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_MRTX1133_"), "MRTX1133", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_RMC6236_"), "RMC-6236", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_ACBI3_"), "ACBI3", drug))
```

```{r}
#rename the reshaped data for join
df_long <- 
  df_long_zscore %>%
  rename(synprime_id = id) %>%
  rename(gene = Gene) %>%
  rename(amino_acid_position = AA.number) %>%
    rename(mutation = Mutation) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, ":")) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut1")) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut2")) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut3")) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut4")) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut5")) %>%
  mutate(mutation_id = paste(gene, mutation, synprime_id)) %>%
  distinct()
  
df_long
```

```{r}
#read in the MAGeCK scores
MAGeCK <- as_tibble(read.csv("MAGeCK_100626.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#left join MAGeCK scores to table
MAGeCK <-
MAGeCK %>%
  select(sgrna, Gene, FDR, LFC, p.low, p.high, Sample) %>%
  rename(synprime_id = sgrna, gene = Gene, LFC_MAGeCK = LFC) %>%
  mutate(p_value = ifelse(LFC_MAGeCK <0, p.low, 
                          ifelse(LFC_MAGeCK >0, p.high,
                                 ""))) 

#rename the Sample to give the drug column
MAGeCK <-
MAGeCK %>%
  filter(Sample %in% c("A427_PE_Ctrl", "A427_PE_BI", "A427_PE_ACBI3", "A427_PE_MRTX", "A427_PE_RMC")) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(Sample == "A427_PE_Ctrl", "control",
                       ifelse(Sample == "A427_PE_BI", "BI-2865",
                              ifelse(Sample == "A427_PE_ACBI3", "ACBI3",
                                      ifelse(Sample == "A427_PE_MRTX", "MRTX1133",
                                             ifelse(Sample == "A427_PE_RMC", "RMC-6236",
                                    "")))))) %>%
  select(-Sample, -p.low, -p.high, -gene) %>%
  distinct()

df_long <-
left_join(df_long, MAGeCK)
```

```{r}
#label highest z-score per variant
KRAS_structure <- 
  KRAS_structure %>%
  group_by(mutation, drug) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(zscore_synprime == max(zscore_synprime) & zscore_synprime > 5,
                        as.character(mutation), NA_character_)) %>%
  ungroup()

domain_labels <- KRAS_structure %>%
  group_by(domain) %>%
  summarise(x_mid = mean(range(amino_acid_position)), .groups = "drop")

KRAS_structure <-
  KRAS_structure %>%
  mutate(drug = factor(drug, levels = c("control", "RMC-6236",  "MRTX1133", "BI-2865","ACBI3"))) %>%
  arrange(drug) %>%
  distinct()

#plot all KRAS data with domain information
plot1 <- ggplot(KRAS_structure, aes(x = amino_acid_position, y = zscore_synprime, colour = drug)) +
geom_point(size = 0.5, position = pos, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=c(0),linetype="dotted") +
        geom_tile(aes(y = -9, fill = domain, colour = NULL), height = 0.70, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = domain_labels,
            aes(x = x_mid, y = -9.8, label = domain),
            colour = "black", size = 2.75,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
theme_classic() +
  xlab("KRAS amino acid position") +
  ylab("A427-PE versus T0 (z-score)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values =c("grey75","black", "black", "black", "black"), guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values =c("black", "red3", "royalblue2", "springgreen4", "salmon", "grey90")) +
geom_text_repel(aes(label = label),
                size = 2, max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE)
plot1
ggsave("KRAS_aa_pos.eps", width = 5, height = 3.5, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
# join sensor data to the new synprime KRAS data
sensor_data <- as_tibble(read.csv("PE_data_long.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))

sensor_data <-
sensor_data %>%
  rename(mutation_id_sensor = mutation_id) %>%
    rename(FDR_sensor = FDR) %>%
      rename(pvalue_sensor = pvalue) %>%
  rename(zscore_sensor = z_score) %>%
  mutate(mutation_type = 
           ifelse(mutation_type == "non_targeting", "non-targeting", 
                  mutation_type))
```

```{r}
sensor_summary <- sensor_data %>%
  group_by(mutation, drug) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_zscore_sensor = mean(zscore_sensor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pegRNA_sensor = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_long_summary <- df_long %>%
  group_by(mutation, drug) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_zscore_synprime = mean(zscore_synprime, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pegRNA_synprime = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#join
join_data <- 
  left_join(df_long_summary, sensor_summary)

join_data
```

```{r}
#replicate correlation Pearson
plot_df <-
  join_data %>%
  filter(is.na(mean_zscore_synprime) == FALSE) %>%
    filter(is.na(mean_zscore_sensor) == FALSE)

r100 <- cor(plot_df$mean_zscore_synprime, plot_df$mean_zscore_sensor, method = "pearson")
cor.test(plot_df$mean_zscore_synprime, plot_df$mean_zscore_sensor, method = "pearson", use="complete.obs")

#correlation between synprime data and sensor data for KRAS
plot1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_zscore_synprime, y = mean_zscore_sensor)) +
geom_pointdensity(size = 0.5, position = pos) +
theme_classic() +
    labs(colour = "density") +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, colour = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(0),linetype="dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(0),linetype="dotted") +
  xlab("KRAS-focused PE screen (z-score)") +
  ylab("sensor PE screen (z-score)") +
  labs(title = "PE screen correlation - KRAS residues") +
  annotate("text", y = 4, x = -3.5, label = paste("r =", round(r100, 2)), parse = FALSE, size = 3.5) 
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(mean_zscore_synprime > 4 &  mean_zscore_sensor >4, paste0(mutation,"-", drug), "")), size=2, max.overlaps = 5, segment.size = 0.2)
plot1
ggsave("cross_modality_correlation.eps", width = 5, height = 4, path ="./figures_export")
```
